messages:
Aisha K.: ok this is not an audition for synchronized swimming but... Onyx discovered the tiny rubber duck and immediately became buoyant. posted a 12s video: https://photos.example/onyx-sploot.mp4
Leo: no way, that little back-leg sploot + float combo is peak content :heart_eyes: :joy: 
Benji: teach me your ways, cat. also `fps=240` slow-mo when you upload pls. 
Aisha K.: will do — the dramatic flop at 00:08 is the main event. also random poll: would anyone want to meet Onyx at the office pet day on Wed? (i'll bring cat-safe treats) 
Leo: yes please. bring the floater. :raised_hands: 
Benji: vote yes. office morale boost guaranteed. :sun_with_face: 
ops-bot: reaction added :thumbsup: by ops-bot 
Aisha K.: uploading a still too for those who can't watch video right now. small PSA: he absolutely hates the hair dryer so i'll bring a towel not a dryer. 
Leo: noted. towel strategy acknowledged. :white_check_mark: 
Benji: caption contest idea: 'When you realize the bathtub is actually a pool' — winner gets free coffee from me. 
Aisha K.: love it. submitting entry: 'floats like a feather, sploots like a pro' :laughing: 
Leo: i'm team 'float and floof' :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
